title: 美银Maddie Jow：黄金牛市是否结束？取决于央行购金和美元走势
speaker: Maddie Jow

segments.en: Gold. I have to ask you, we briefly dipped below 4,000. Right now, I mean, is this rally, this bull market that we're seeing gold, do you think it's over, given the fact that there are a lot of concerns about the strength of the dollar now?
segments.zh: 黄金。我们短暂跌破了4000美元。现在，你认为黄金的涨势、牛市是否结束了？考虑到目前对美元走强的担忧。

segments.en: I think compared to like other metals like aluminum and copper, gold in our view, it's more of a belief, right? And then also, so compared to copper, you don't have that much actual need like building the grid, like the ESS, et cetera.
segments.zh: 我认为与其他金属如铝和铜相比，黄金更多是一种信仰。与铜相比，黄金没有那么多实际需求，如电网建设、储能系统等。

segments.en: So, gold is more like whether the rate hike, strong US dollar, et cetera. So, in the near term, I think clients are quite concerned on gold as well.
segments.zh: 所以黄金更多受加息、美元走强等因素影响。短期内，我认为客户对黄金也很担忧。

segments.en: Also, another thing that will impact is central bank buying. We started to see China central bank buying in a gradual phases. So, it really depends on at what level, maybe Chinese central bank or some other central bank will come up to buy.
segments.zh: 另一个影响因素是央行购金。我们开始看到中国央行分阶段购金。所以这取决于在什么价位，中国央行或其他央行会入场购买。

segments.en: Otherwise, from a dollar, from a yield, from a rate cut perspective, probably is losing the momentum to upside.
segments.zh: 否则，从美元、收益率、降息角度看，可能失去上行动力。
